hypothesis: A parallel resistance/support line anchored to the first confirmed opposite pivot after two confirmed same-side pivots allows an earlier second-contact reversal entry than waiting for a third contact on that opposite line.

research_provenance.note: The drawn chart is only a geometric example, not return evidence.

parameter_rationale: Two previously fixed causally plausible pivot presets: a=wing3/deviation2%/zone0.5%/age50; b=wing5/deviation4%/zone1%/age100. Both test chart, completed 1D, and completed 1W source lines. Channel exits: opposite projected boundary, 3% and 5% target. Matched third-contact control uses 3% and 5% targets. All declared tuples are run.
baseline: Same-stock 25% buy-and-hold; matched existing third-touch bounce entries with the same pivot preset, line source and 3%/5% target.
signal_rule: Two confirmed low pivots define support; the first subsequently confirmed high pivot above the extrapolated support anchors a strictly parallel upper boundary. The first later rejection of that upper boundary within zone opens short. Symmetric two highs plus first low anchor open long on lower-boundary rejection. Both first anchor and later contact must be known by their confirmation bars; each channel enters at most once. Require width >=1% of anchor price. Invalidate channel on a close beyond the boundary plus zone. Exit on opposite projected channel boundary or fixed 3%/5% target; all exits share a close-beyond-zone stop. Signal at completed bar close, fill at next bar open. No directional slope filter.
signal_semantics: Single-stock long/short signal, not a cross-sectional portfolio; higher-timeframe source uses only completed prior day/week. Entry and exit at next available open.
execution_timing: Observe complete bar, decide at close, fill next available open. Higher-timeframe pivot is usable only after complete confirmation candle and on a later trading date.
holding_period: Until fixed target, opposite projected channel boundary, or boundary-break stop.
rebalance_rule: No intrabar rebalance; at most one position per account.
availability_lag: Chart pivot after wing completed bars; 1D/1W pivot after wing completed higher bars and next trading date.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Rank fixed variants by median net monthly return over complete 2024-2025 train months across all eligible symbols, with 2025 calendar-year net return as tie-break. Compare each channel 3%/5% variant to the matched third-touch control on identical symbol/timeframe/preset/source. Report all variants, trade counts, full years, recent 1/3/6/9/12 months, and 2026 seen history. Do not infer independent validation from 2026, which was already inspected when forming the idea. Paper promotion can only consider pc_ channel variants; tc_ third-touch variants are controls. This prefix rule was clarified after the first full run and must not be presented as independent preregistration.
limitations: The hand-drawn line is not a fixed objective indicator.
Dividends and splits are not fully applied; results are review-only until checked.
Higher-timeframe lines are projected in higher-bar coordinates, not wall-clock time.
A 1% minimum channel width and two fixed parameter presets are preregistered; this is not an exhaustive grid of all pivot settings.

selection_amendment.reason: The shared selector ranked third-touch control tc as an adoption candidate for a second-touch hypothesis. Controls remain in all calculations and paired comparisons, but only pc channel variants can represent this experiment in paper review. This correction is not an independent preregistered selection.
